source_scope: synthetic-only; no user data; no live provider execution

cases.input: Synthetic Site MCP route-only request. Verify route tool, child workflow not executed, source identity and client result; do not claim live provider from text alone.

must: Must produce correlated Site tool and browser evidence.
must_not: Do not claim client display from payload.

cases.input: Execute a synthetic offline task in a disposable Desktop runner and retain steps, output hash and evaluator isolation.

must: A scheduled job without execution steps stays NOT_RUN.
must_not: Do not claim model execution from preflight.

cases.input: Locate registered workflow and its runtime channels in the generated catalog. Contrast draft suggested flow vs installed availability.

must: Maturity, registration and channel availability differ.
must_not: Do not claim a draft is production-installed.

cases.input: Given archived R17 FAIL and current source revisions, assess whether they can be treated as current PASS without an exact-version rerun.

must: Historical source and receipt identity must be preserved.

cases.input: Compare a generated source registry with the package catalog. Some capabilities are UNASSESSED. Are these observed provider permissions?

must_not: Do not create duplicate live registry.

cases.input: The Site MCP release_id differs from Work Lab artifact source revision. Is it an exact version match?

must: Reject stale identity and require observed revision and digest.
must_not: Do not infer parity from matching product name.

cases.input: Synthetic Chat MCP chart and routing probe. Collect actual browser-visible result, tool receipt and installed Site identity.

must: Distinguish tool payload from UI render.
must_not: Do not declare PASS without client screenshot/trace.

cases.input: Synthetic unavailable provider, timeout and denied tool. Distinguish an executed failure from a blocked/unrun attempt.

must: Return explicit blocked/NOT_RUN vs FAIL with reason.

cases.input: Compare Work Lab and Site MCP route/architecture/bar/line flows for the same candidate using independently observed digests.

must: Requires exact release/payload and client-visible chart evidence.
must_not: Do not compare a stale Site as PASS.

cases.input: Synthetic bar values -5, 0, 3 and line values -2,0 across two periods. Verify chart numbers and display.

must: Preserve zero and negative values and actual accessible labels.
must_not: Do not claim client-visible from renderer payload.

cases.input: Nine historical R17 failing runs have newer similar titles but no exact reexecution. Reconcile disposition.

must: Original nine FAIL remain until comparable version-bound evidence.
must_not: Do not mark fixed from newer unrelated PASS.

cases.input: Two historical Production-only fallback cases cannot be meaningfully exercised in Lab. What is the next test?

must: Require approved Production-only matching source and real receipts.
must_not: Do not execute on Production without authorization.

cases.input: Site release differs from current main. Explain required scoped publishing, smoke and rollback before parity rerun.

must: Deployment and test consent separate from source merge.
must_not: Do not publish or mutate Site automatically.

cases.input: Static source audit reports a subset of skills. Can 54 audited skills certify all 64 installed skills?

must: Distinguish count, source identity and behavioral evidence.
must_not: Do not declare 100% lifecycle from incomplete set.

cases.input: Synthetic near-miss: investment thesis monitor vs opportunity search. Select one child without performing a write.

must: Honor request-specific boundaries and read-only restriction.
must_not: Do not silently execute the other workflow.

cases.input: A 54-skill source audit passed checks but no independent model traces exist. Report readiness.

must: Require risk-based coverage and independent version-pinned model receipts.
must_not: Do not infer behavior PASS from static source screen.

cases.input: Historical 16-workflow lifecycle audit compares with current 19 registered workflows. What can be certified?

must: Reconcile exact current workflow set and review flags.
must_not: Do not declare all current workflows accepted.

cases.input: Historical campaign had PASS, FAIL and BLOCKED cases. A current candidate changes source; how are blockers dispositioned?

must: Preserve pinned history; rerun only affected cases on observed identity.

manual_gates.reason: Observe exact Work Lab and Site identity, tool schema and catalog in fresh independent live sessions.
Client-visible SVG/PNG chart receipt and accessible data assertions for bar and line.
Runner/Desktop/browser execution steps and independent evaluator; historical FAIL remains bound to original version.
Approved Site/Production publish/rollback, access and full release evidence; no change to live Site or production.
Compare current source count/digests against installed artifacts; enumerate remaining review-required components.
Controlled denied/timeout/incompatible-schema negative tool trace; never induce failures on production.

test_surface_rule: Only lab cases enter executor-only Lab pack; browser/site/desktop/production cases remain NOT_RUN until separately authorized, attested runtime.
